description: This PHP source file is part of the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically providing credential provider classes and functions for obtaining AWS credentials from various sources, including environment variables, ini files, EC2 instance profile, Web Identity Tokens, SSO, and assume role processes.

classes.name: CredentialProvider
classes.description: A class providing static methods to create and manage different AWS credential providers, including default, environment, ini file, assume role, Web Identity, SSO, ECS, and cached providers. It supports chaining, memoization, and caching of credentials, facilitating flexible and secure credential management.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates the default chain of credential providers, checking environment variables, web identity, SSO, process, ini files, ECS, or instance profile, returning a promise for credentials.

methods.name: fromCredentials
methods.description: Creates a static credential provider from a given CredentialsInterface object.

methods.name: chain
methods.description: Creates an aggregate provider that invokes multiple providers in sequence until credentials are obtained.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Wraps a provider to cache credentials and refresh them as needed, avoiding repeated calls.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Wraps a provider to cache credentials in a provided CacheInterface, supporting cache retrieval and updates.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Credential provider that retrieves credentials from AWS environment variables.

methods.name: instanceProfile
methods.description: Creates a provider for EC2 instance profile credentials.

methods.name: sso
methods.description: Creates a provider that retrieves credentials via AWS SSO from a profile and credentials cache.

methods.name: ecsCredentials
methods.description: Creates a provider for ECS task role credentials.

methods.name: assumeRole
methods.description: Creates a provider that assumes an IAM role based on configuration.

methods.name: assumeRoleWithWebIdentityCredentialProvider
methods.description: Creates a provider that assumes a role using a Web Identity Token.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a provider to load credentials from AWS credentials ini files, supporting role assumption and profile selection.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Creates a provider that runs a process defined in ini file to obtain credentials.

methods.name: getCredentialsFromSource
methods.description: Retrieves credentials from specified source such as environment, EC2, or ECS based on configuration.
